ranked.headline: Genetic and epigenetic variants prioritized by effects on transcript regulation
ranked.summary: Current work pairs expression models with external GWAS, TWAS, and methylation evidence to test whether predicted regulatory variants hold up.

ranked.headline: Pretrained biomolecular encoders and generative priors reused for design and prediction
ranked.summary: Recent work couples pretrained biomolecular representations with structural, geometric, and experimental constraints for design and prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Reference representation shapes somatic variant calling accuracy in cancer genomics
ranked.summary: Pangenome and personalized references are entering somatic variant calling, alongside error models for low-frequency detection.

ranked.headline: Graph and transcriptomic models predict drug interactions, degradability and response
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair predictive drug models with mechanistic readouts and held-out evaluation, though not uniformly across items.

ranked.headline: Nanopore adaptive sampling and metagenomic profiling reshape microbial genome recovery
ranked.summary: Recent work shows tool, database and parameter choices alter microbial diversity results, while nanopore workflows target genomes directly.

ranked.headline: Multimodal protein representations are being fused to predict interactions and function
ranked.summary: Protein language model embeddings are being paired with structural and sequence features to improve interaction, affinity, and function prediction.

ranked.headline: Reference-anchored benchmarks validate quantification, grouping and diffusion inference
ranked.summary: Known-truth references now test quantification, synthetic clustering and diffusion estimates before downstream biological inference is trusted.

ranked.headline: Bounded parameter and yield sets for uncertain biomolecular and metabolic models
ranked.summary: Bounded solution sets, rather than single parameterizations, are being certified or narrowed for models with unfixed parameters or network logic.

ranked.headline: Computational prediction of binding sites, poses and affinities upstream of assays
ranked.summary: Open, adaptable prediction models are now benchmarked against binding, potency and free energy data in drug discovery workflows.

ranked.headline: Integrating histology, scRNA-seq and spatial transcriptomics to resolve tissue niches
ranked.summary: Computational fusion of histology, single-cell and spatial expression data now extends from domain calling toward geometry and inferred temporal ordering.

ranked.headline: Learned models assign protein domains, residue function, and gene roles from sequence data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply learned models to domain, residue, paralog, and gene-function prediction across proteomes and transcriptomes.

ranked.headline: Software frameworks extract network and tissue topology structure from omics data
ranked.summary: New omics tools model network, pathway, and tissue structure with explicit stability or null-model validation.

ranked.headline: Computational frameworks couple single-cell multiomics with pooled perturbation readouts
ranked.summary: Multimodal pooled screens and benchmarks now pair RNA, protein, chromatin, and imaging readouts with computational integration at single-cell resolution.

ranked.headline: Biological ML predictions need explicit tests for bias, confounding, and reliability
ranked.summary: Recent items show LLM, genomic, aging-clock, and survival models can look plausible or inflated while lacking systematic validation of their outputs.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic network models tested against population structure and latent geometry
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a PubMed article evaluate explicit neural mechanisms through latent geometry, dynamical stability, and fit to neural responses.

ranked.headline: Reference-grade genome assemblies across diverse non-model eukaryotes
ranked.summary: Long-read PacBio HiFi and hifiasm workflows now yield chromosome-level references for non-model invertebrates and tick vectors.

ranked.headline: Scalable software for nucleic acid structure, alignment and phylogenetic inference
ranked.summary: Recent tools deliver linear-time, parallelized and large-scale implementations for RNA structure, phylogenetic network and alignment analyses.

ranked.headline: Computational methods sample protein conformational ensembles and dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints benchmark AI ensemble predictors and link MD, explainable AI and statistical microstates to protein 3D ensembles.

ranked.headline: Variant prioritization moves toward mechanistic and tissue-resolved interpretation
ranked.summary: Deep-learning and tensor-based frameworks now link noncoding and missense variant effects to cell types, tissues, and protein features.

ranked.headline: Deep models infer single-cell gene regulation and disentangle technical variation
ranked.summary: Paired multi-omic and single-cell datasets now support predictive models of regulatory networks, developmental dynamics, and batch or cell-cycle structure.

ranked.headline: Machine learning and workflow tools decode splicing and enhancer-promoter regulation
ranked.summary: Explainable models, changepoint detection and transformer-based design now target splicing and regulatory readouts from RNA-seq and chromatin data.

ranked.headline: Electrostatics and standardized definitions precede quantitative extraction from data
ranked.summary: Quantitative interpretation of simulated and recorded observables now requires explicit physical models and standardized feature definitions.

ranked.headline: Pangenome graphs of near-complete haplotypes resolve segmental duplications
ranked.summary: Near-complete haplotype assemblies and graph-based representations are improving reconstruction of medically relevant complex genomic regions.

ranked.headline: Computational dynamics guide pathogen targets and SARS-CoV-2 spike antibody binding
ranked.summary: Mutation-level simulations now connect spike recombination and antibody binding to functional readouts in pathogen systems.

ranked.headline: Residue-level contact networks and ordered metrics expose structural reorganization
ranked.summary: Benchmarks of AlphaFold3, Boltz-2 and cryo-EM Cα predictors expose gaps in capturing bound-state disorder and density-level detail.

ranked.headline: Machine learning for omics: generative models, language models, and fairness benchmarks
ranked.summary: Generative, language-model, and benchmarking approaches are being applied to omics data for prediction, sequencing, and cross-population evaluation.

ranked.headline: Deep models now span antibody, TCR, and pMHC recognition and peptide design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair PLM embeddings, graph attention, and AlphaFold2 with epitope, TCR, and peptide prediction across immune targets.

ranked.headline: Routine molecular data used to infer reproductive, dose, and drug-response states
ranked.summary: Bulk transcriptomic and drug-response profiles are being tested for dose, viability, and potency inference against prior platforms and alternative pipelines.

ranked.headline: Ontology-anchored biomedical graphs add admissibility rules and cell-type normalization
ranked.summary: Recent work extends biomedical knowledge graphs toward constrained inference, entity normalization, and joint text-and-numeric graph generation.

ranked.headline: Compressed and indexed representations enabling fast genomic sequence analysis
ranked.summary: New algorithms and binary formats address the memory and throughput limits of large-scale genomic sequence processing.

ranked.headline: Error-aware tools tackle nanopore barcoding and long-read amplicon variant recovery
ranked.summary: Indel-rich errors and Nanopore barcoding artefacts now demand dedicated demultiplexing, variant recovery and simulation tools.

ranked.headline: Long-read isoform models now feed genome browser visualization and proteogenomics
ranked.summary: Long-read isoform models are moving beyond sequence recovery into curation, browser visualization, and protein-level analysis.

ranked.headline: Frameworks design state-switching and disordered proteins via physics-based models
ranked.summary: Inverse-design frameworks now target protein state switching, disordered ensembles, and large-scale regulatory circuit robustness.

ranked.headline: Learned and physics-informed models infer hidden mechanical and molecular dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair simulation-trained networks and Bayesian or backpropagation inference with microscopy, optical-tweezers, and single-molecule data.

ranked.headline: Phylogenetic and learned-representation tools refine prokaryotic and viral classification
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published toolkit apply phylogeny, structure, and foundation-model embeddings to prokaryotic and viral classification.

ranked.headline: Curated atlases unify human and mouse single-cell and spatial developmental data
ranked.summary: Uniform reprocessing of hundreds of public datasets now yields reusable reference atlases spanning embryonic to adult tissue.

ranked.headline: MD simulations link membrane and sequence context to complex conformational dynamics
ranked.summary: Membrane lipids, tail sequence and interface perturbations are now resolved at atomistic resolution through MD-based analyses of assemblies.

ranked.headline: Reproducible bioinformatics workflows via web services, scaffolds, and LLM pipelines
ranked.summary: Recent preprints address reproducibility and packaging of bioinformatics software, including LLM-driven pipeline generation.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools for molecular maps, genome annotation, alignment and Hi-C
ranked.summary: Four tools published 1 June 2026 address map parsing, annotation standardisation, alignment visualisation and ssDNA Hi-C analysis.

ranked.headline: Inferring tissue and tumor states from spatial, single-cell, and metabolic data
ranked.summary: Recent spatial atlases and multimodal inference studies extend computational tissue mapping toward metabolic flux and reference-anchored state assignment.
